purpose: Teach: 王者/焦り/断る/発散/流用/取り残さ/風情/跡地

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の王者として、品質、譲るな。
lines.en: As the industry leader, never compromise on quality.
lines.style: Measured authority. Crisp attack on each clause. Pauses between thoughts like checking a ledger. No room for negotiation — stated as fact, not opinion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。焦りで、判断ミス、避けます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll avoid making poor decisions under pressure.
lines.style: Steady, respectful confirmation. Slightly formal cadence — the careful speech of someone being held to a standard they accept. Brief, clipped, no elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 不当な要求、断る勇気、持て。
lines.en: Have the courage to refuse unreasonable demands.
lines.style: Firm directive. Weight lands on 'courage' — it's not a suggestion, it's a requirement. Lean forward slightly in the delivery. Authoritative but not unkind.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員のストレス、発散する場、設けています。
lines.en: Yes. We have outlets for staff to decompress and manage stress.
lines.style: Professional report-tone. A beat of pride in the practical solution. Even and informative, showing that he's thought this through and implemented it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 予算流用、絶対に避けろ。
lines.en: Under no circumstances allow budget misallocation.
lines.style: Absolute finality. Clipped rhythm on each word. No warmth here — pure instruction. The voice of someone who has seen this mistake before and will not see it again.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地方支店、取り残されない経営、目指します。
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to ensuring the regional branches aren't left behind.
lines.style: Earnest commitment stated plainly. A note of protectiveness — he means to include everyone. Steady pace, no rush, conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 歴史ある社屋、風情、保てよ。
lines.en: Preserve the character and atmosphere of our historic building.
lines.style: Tender moment beneath the authority. A slight soften on 'preserve' — this building matters. Not nostalgic, but respectful of what was built before. Deliberate and careful.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。廃工場の跡地、再開発計画、検討中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reviewing redevelopment plans for the old factory site.
lines.style: Focused update. The tone of someone balancing competing values — honoring the past while planning forward. Clear and methodical, showing the work is underway.
